intervals_icu.auth: HTTP basic username API_KEY; password from INTERVALS_ICU_API_KEY via urllib User-Agent, not a command-line argument

weekly_template.Mon: 60 min Z2 (easy spin the day after the long ride)
weekly_template.Wed: quality session 1 (sweet spot, threshold, FTP check, or openers - see the week table)
weekly_template.Thu: upper-body, light, or rest (no heavy legs, no Zwift ride)
weekly_template.Fri: quality session 2, then heavy lower-body strength after the ride or at least 6 h apart the same day
weekly_template.Sun: rest (optional 40 min very-easy spin is in the workout library if you want it)

days_off.YYYY-MM-DD: travel or other planned day off

picks.Mon_Z2_60: Coco 2.6 (Betty 2.4 if legs are heavy after the long ride)
picks.Sat_long_no_tempo: Yumi 2.9 for the full duration (Coco 2.6 if HR drifts more than 5% in the second half)
picks.Sat_long_with_tempo: Use the structured .zwo (tempo blocks need ERG). Optional: a mid-pack bot for the Z2 portions.
picks.recovery_weeks_4_9_12_easy_rides: Betty 2.4 (Maria 2.2 when returning from travel or illness)
picks.Wk01-03_Fri_spinups: Coco 2.6, and do the 30s spin-ups at 110 rpm in the bunch

robopacer.rules: Ride time-based (leave when the planned duration is done). Sit in the draft; real power will run about 10-20% under the bot. Drop to the next-slower bot if HR drifts or RPE goes above 4. Never use a bot on quality days (sweet spot, threshold, VO2, openers, FTP test).

morning_readiness.questions: sleep hours; sleep quality 1-5; legs 1-5; energy 1-5; stress 1-5 (5 = most stressed); night waking and cause; resting HR optional
